text.p: Pen pictures of the likely Ajax Amsterdam squad for Sunday's Dutch first division game against Feyenoord.

Edwin van der Sar. Goalkeeper. Age 26. Product of Ajax's celebrated youth policy, has been a regular for the Dutch champions since March 1993. Tall, commanding, unflappable. Number one keeper for the Dutch national side.
Frank de Boer. Central defender. Age 26. Automatic selection at the back for club and country. Dead-ball specialist. Captain in Danny Blind's absence.

Winston Bogarde. Defender. Age 26. Bought from Sparta Rotterdam two seasons ago, tough-tackling powerhouse has made his mark as a first-team regular. Versatile player who has appeared at left-back, in midfield and up front.

John Veldman. Right back. Age 28. Tall, lithe defender joined from Sparta Rotterdam in the summer as a replacement for Italy-bound Michael Reiziger. Has yet to score in over 230 league games for Ajax, Sparta, Willem II and PSV Eindhoven.

Santos. Defender. Age 27. Tall, commanding Brazilian, part of the World Cup winning squad, but currently out of favour with Ajax. Coach Louis van Gaal dropped him, complaining that he hampered Ajax's fluid style. Some in the media hinted he may have been dropped for criticising his coach in a magazine interview. In his second year at Ajax but Dutch is not among his four fluent languages.

Tijani Babangida. Midfield. Age 23. Small, pacy winger bought from Roda JC in the summer. Member of Nigeria's Olympic gold-medal winning side. Needs to improve the supply side of his game and his finishing is suspect, too.

Marc Overmars. Midfield. Age 23. Class act wide on the left, drifting past defenders with pace and excellent close control. Has provided valuable goals for club and country. Back in the reckoning after an enforced nine-month lay-off following knee surgery.

Arnold Scholten. Midfield. Age 33. Surprise buy early last season from Feyenoord to fill in for the departing Edgar Davids. Tall and languid, he scored his first goal in 35 European games in Ajax's 1-0 Champions' league win against Rangers in Glasgow.
Kiki Musampa. Midfield. Age 19. Fringe player thrust into first-team action due to club's dire injury situation. Regular for Dutch Under-21 side. Versatile.
Ronald de Boer. Midfield. Age 26. Twin brother of Frank. Plays key support role for strikers from right midfield. An Ajax regular since being re-bought from Twente in 1993.

Jari Litmanen. Midfield/Striker. Age 25. Silky smooth Finnish striker joined Ajax in 1992 as reserve to Dennis Bergkamp but took his chance when the Dutchman left. Has suffered recent loss of form and is carrying an injury. Ajax's leading marksman in Europe with 19 goals.

Dani. Striker. Age 19. Portuguese teenager who burst on to the Ajax scene with two goals in his European debut against Glasgow Rangers last month. Van Gaal promptly dropped him, saying he did not yet fit the Ajax system. Had a brief spell on loan at West Ham in London last season.

Patrick Kluivert. Striker. Age 20. Joined Ajax youth aged seven and blooded in the first-team at 17. International debut at 18. Top scorer in his first two seasons for Ajax and fast approaching a half century of goals for club. Top league scorer this season with three goals. Youngest player to score in a European Cup final. Earlier this year escaped jail for vehicular homicide. Only recently back from long injury. Contract expires in the summer and many fancy he will join top British club.
